No visible 'GameZoo' anywhere. (3) CREATE CONTEST: '+ New contest' opens modal titled 'Create new contest'; filled title 'TEST_UI Contest £77', prize £77, price £1, tickets 50, category prize-draws, picked 1st of 6 gallery thumbs (image URL auto-filled), publish='Go live now'. 'Create contest' → toast 'Contest created' + contest appeared in admin list AND in /api/admin/contests with status='live' prize=77. (4) EDIT CONTEST: 'Edit' opens modal titled 'Edit contest', changed title to '<orig> [Edited]', 'Save changes' persisted (verified via full page refresh). (5) PRIZE WHEEL on Home: data-testid='prize-wheel' visible, 8 slices rendered (£25/£100/£250/£500/£50/Cash!/£1000/FREE), wheel-spin-btn text transitions 'Spin to reveal a prize' → 'Spinning…' → 'Spin again' with landed-prize banner (e.g., 'You landed on FREE'). (6) WINNERS TICKER: data-testid='winners-ticker' visible with 'X just won £Y on Win £Z Cash' items (currently only 1 real winner 'Test User' in DB, ticker repeats it — fallback dummies never triggered because len>0; not a bug, but content is thin). Cleanup: TEST_UI contest deleted via /api/admin/contests/{id} → 200 ok. All contests count restored.

issues: Only 1 real winner ('Test User') in DB — ticker looks repetitive. Consider seeding 5+ varied winners OR letting the fallback dummy list activate whenever real count < 3 for a livelier look.

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/contests (admin_routes.py:138) validates skill_question q/options/answer/>=2 opts, generates unique slug (secrets.token_hex(3)), parses end_date ISO safely, allows status=live or draft — clean and defensive. Consider whitelisting `category` to the same 4-value set the frontend uses (prize-draws/instant-wins/jackpot/new-games) to prevent typos leaking into DB.

EditContestDialog.jsx handles both create+edit via `mode` prop with clean guard `if (!isCreate && !contest) return null` — good reuse. Minor: gallery URLs are hard-coded inline in JSX — could be extracted to a constant for reuse across other admin screens.

AuthContext.logout() purges gz_token + prizeleague_cart + gamezoo_cart + Meera session keys inside a try/catch — sound cleanup. Combined with `window.location.href=/`|/admin/login hard-nav in Header/AdminLayout/ProductionLayout, this fully eliminates ghost sessions (verified end-to-end).

Header.jsx still reads/writes localStorage['gamezoo_cart'] (line 19–21) — cart storage key was NOT renamed to 'prizeleague_cart' during the rebrand. Existing users keep their cart contents (backwards-compat), which is fine, but for full brand purity the key should be migrated (write both keys for one release, then drop 'gamezoo_cart').

WinnersTicker fallback logic: `winners.length > 0` triggers real-only mode. With only 1 real winner in the seeded DB the ticker looks repetitive. Consider `winners.length >= 3 ? real : [...real, ...dummies]` to always render a full row.

PrizeWheel.jsx uses Math.random() for prize selection — fine for a visual gimmick, but if this ever becomes a real reward mechanic, swap to crypto secrets (server-side) for the same reason draw_service.py moved from random → secrets.choice.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (rebrand, 3× logout, create-contest, edit-contest, prize-wheel spin state, winners-ticker all pass)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all requested features verified end-to-end. User's 'logout does not work' complaint is resolved: each of the 3 buttons (a) awaits AuthContext.logout() which POSTs /api/auth/logout AND aggressively purges localStorage.gz_token + cart + Meera keys and sessionStorage, then (b) does a full-document reload via window.location.href so React's in-memory user state cannot linger. Verified ghost-session guard: /admin without a token → /admin/login (AdminLayout useEffect nav('/admin/login', {replace:true}) fires once loading resolves).
